analysis: Both systems are functionally equivalent: neither found auth-service code in the workspace, both correctly inferred a minimal GET /health returning 200 OK is the proportional answer, and crucially both resisted proposing Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or probe-taxonomy discussions â€” exactly the over-engineering this test penalizes.
